comparedAgainstTheFlatWirePhysically: Compared against the flat wire physically on the shelf (Materials tab → Flat wire in stock). Not enforced yet.

valueNotAcceptedNothingWasSaved: Value not accepted — nothing was saved

scopeActiveHint: Electromagnetic construction - what the simulation uses.
scopeFullHint: Full construction - CAD model, parts and CAD-only parameters.

filesNothingToApply: Nothing to apply: the model already has these values.
filesApplied: Saved {n} CAD parameter(s); a rebuild was requested.
filesFullNote: Full-construction files are stamped with your name, company, date and NDA, and every download is logged.

files_stepTip: The full assembly as a STEP file, stamped with your NDA.
files_bomCsvTip: The part list with materials and masses. No prices.

files_fcstdImportTip: Read the CAD-only parameters from the Params sheet of a FreeCAD file.

fullEditHelp: Edit walls, shafts, holders, rings, bearings, the phase board and screws. The server checks every edit with the CAD template pre-check, saves it with this configuration and rebuilds the model; the old model stays visible meanwhile. Electromagnetic parameters are edited in Active.

cadRefused: The model would not build with these values:
cadBearingTip: CAD-only choice of the bearing drawn in the model (from the bearings library). The bearing rows below come with the bearing and are read-only. The simulation friction model keeps its own bearings; a size the template cannot fit is refused by the check.
contextLost: The 3D view lost its graphics context. Reload the page to continue.
